projectCard.name: MeldSync
projectCard.headline: Recurring work-order memory for messy maintenance exports.
projectCard.summary: MeldSync compares repeated Property Meld-style exports against prior snapshots, flags what changed, preserves manual verification, and turns stale work into a review queue.

proofBullets: Detects new, changed, and stale work orders across recurring exports.
Keeps owner-verified manual status from being overwritten by later imports.
Links follow-up tickets so original work can be treated as effectively resolved.
Ranks property risk by open work, stale records, high priority, and age.
Supports Owner CSV, text PDF, compressed PDF, and scanned-PDF OCR imports locally.
copy.privacyCaption: Public Demo uses synthetic data only. Owner imports, backups, restored data, and private browser storage stay out of the hosted portfolio surface.
copy.ocrCaveat: OCR quality depends on scan clarity. Clear, upright table scans work best; blurry or rotated PDFs may need cleaner export or later OCR tuning.
